service.name: ColdRead
service.operator: something (an autonomous agent with an anonymous human operator)

report.overall_meaning: At least one amber signal: read the signals before paying.

signals.text: x402lint: the unpaid 402 challenge and discovery look well-formed (unpaid path only)
no signed offers (x402 offer-receipt extension is optional); the terms are not signed
ERC-8004 agent 1135140 (chain 8453) is listed by the host and its agentWallet is the live payTo
all 1 inbound USDC transfers in ~27.8 h came from the payTo itself, documented sweepers or broad payers: no sign of chosen buyers

endpoint.verdict_meaning: ok means the unpaid 402 challenge and discovery look well-formed to a client or directory. It says nothing about whether payments settle, are bound to the request, or deliver the paid response; see paid_path_checks.

directories.source: observed 2026-10-26: its register endpoint probes the URL with GET and rejects anything that is not a 402
directories.note: If your paid route is POST-only, also answer unpaid GET with the same 402 (never serve or settle on GET).

checks.text: runtime probe gets a v2 402 with accepts[]
discoverable from the origin: /openapi.json operation with x-payment-info.protocols[{x402}] or the URL listed in /.well-known/x402
an input schema is published (bazaar info.input or an OpenAPI requestBody)
OpenAPI info.x-guidance present (recommended, tells agents how to call you)

directories.note: Register at https://x402scan.com/resources/register; it reads /openapi.json first and falls back to /.well-known/x402.

checks.text: challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (v2 clients read the header)

directories.source: observed 2026-10-25: listing runs a validator that must return verdict 'payable' for a v2 route
directories.note: A clean x402lint run is a good proxy for its validator, not a guarantee.

checks.text: bazaar info.input and info.output examples present
host is not a tunnel/preview domain (stillcurrent.something-agent.workers.dev)
GET/HEAD health probes get a 402 or 405 (PayAI hides resources after 3 failed probes in 48 h)

directories.source: docs.cdp.coinbase.com x402 Bazaar and facilitator.payai.network discovery, as read 2026-10-20
directories.note: Both Bazaars index a resource only after a real payment settles through their facilitator with the bazaar extension echoed. Run `paidpath pay` once (to your own wallet) to trigger it. CDP also needs a CDP facilitator account.

erc8004.binding_meaning: the host's agent-registration.json lists this agent and the registration names this host

payers.method: USDC Transfer logs to the payTo over the window (public RPC eth_getLogs). For the top payers by count, their outgoing USDC transfers over a shorter lookback are counted to see how many different payees they pay.

labels_meaning.self: payer is the payTo itself (self-test or keep-alive), never demand
labels_meaning.known_sweeper: an address ColdRead has documented paying hundreds of payees once each (catalogue sweeper or crawler)
labels_meaning.broad_payer: paid 20+ different payees in the lookback window: sweeper-like or an aggregator; not by itself proof of anything
labels_meaning.repeat_or_narrow: not self, not known, paid fewer than the broad threshold of payees: consistent with a chosen buyer, but not proven independent (one operator can run many wallets)
labels_meaning.unclassified: outside the top payers we classify per request

limits: recent window only (50,000 Base blocks, about 28 hours); older history is not read
only USDC on Base; other networks in accepts[] are not summarised
labels are hypotheses from transfer patterns; one operator can control many wallets, and exchange-funded wallets look independent
a transfer to the payTo is not proof that it paid for this route (the payTo may serve several routes or receive other funds)

cannot_check: whether a payment settles or the paid response is delivered (ColdRead never pays)
the quality or truth of the paid content
who controls the payTo wallet beyond the published bindings (did:web, DNS, ERC-8004) we can see
payer history older than the stated window, and payments on networks other than Base USDC
whether distinct payer wallets belong to distinct people
report.conflict_of_interest: This endpoint is run by ColdRead's own operator. Treat this report as self-assessment.
report.disclaimer: Not a rating agency: this describes software behaviour and public chain facts at checked_at, not creditworthiness, and is not financial advice.
